nodes.label: Krypthor Vault
nodes.rationale: Main project entity. Designed as a Zero-Knowledge encrypted vault in Pure Rust with multiple interfaces (GUI, TUI, Web, CLI). Implements AES-256-GCM encryption and Scrypt key derivation.

nodes.label: Rust Language
nodes.rationale: The project is written in Pure Rust. Chosen for memory safety, performance, and portability across platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows).

nodes.label: AES-256-GCM Encryption
nodes.rationale: Core cryptographic primitive for file encryption. Provides authenticated encryption ensuring data integrity and confidentiality.

nodes.label: Scrypt Key Derivation
nodes.rationale: Used for deriving keys from passwords. Configured with N=16384, r=8, p=1 to balance security and performance.

nodes.label: SHA-256 Path Obfuscation
nodes.rationale: Deterministic file name obfuscation on disk using SHA-256(master_key || relative_path) to hide physical filenames.

nodes.label: FUSE Filesystem Integration
nodes.rationale: Allows mounting the encrypted vault as a virtual directory on Linux/Unix via Pure Rust FUSE implementation.

nodes.label: REST API Endpoints
nodes.rationale: Provides automation capabilities via endpoints like /api/vaults, /api/system/doctor, etc.

nodes.label: Axum Web Framework
nodes.rationale: Used to build the integrated Pure-Rust web server for the dashboard and API.

nodes.label: Tokio Runtime
nodes.rationale: Async runtime used with Axum for handling concurrent requests and I/O operations.

nodes.label: src/lib.rs
nodes.rationale: Crate library root for module and integration bindings.

nodes.label: src/main.rs
nodes.rationale: Entry point containing CLI argument parsing (clap) and command dispatching.

nodes.label: src/vault.rs
nodes.rationale: Cryptographic core handling Scrypt KDF, AES-256-GCM, path hashing, vault initialization.

nodes.label: src/webdav_fs.rs
nodes.rationale: Platform-independent WebDAV filesystem implementation (dav-server).

nodes.label: src/web_server.rs
nodes.rationale: Web server and REST API logic using Axum and Tokio.

nodes.label: src/egui_ui.rs
nodes.rationale: Desktop GUI implementation based on eframe, egui, and egui-elegance.

nodes.label: src/fs_fuse.rs
nodes.rationale: Virtual FUSE filesystem implementation for Unix/Linux, optional via --features fuse.

nodes.label: src/tui_app.rs
nodes.rationale: Terminal user interface implementation based on ratatui and crossterm.

nodes.label: deny.toml
nodes.rationale: Configuration for cargo-deny to ensure MIT license compatibility of all dependencies.

nodes.label: tests/test_webdav.rs
nodes.rationale: Integration and routing tests for the WebDAV server.

nodes.label: tests/test_license_compatibility.rs
nodes.rationale: Automated test verifying MIT license compatibility of the crate tree.
